name: finance_tracker
description: A simple FastAPI backend to serve APIs for a finance tracking application.

scripts.build:frontend: cd static && pnpm install && pnpm build --emptyOutDir
scripts.docker-up: docker compose up -d mysql redis celery_worker celery_beat
scripts.start: npm run docker-up && concurrently "npm run start:dev:api" "npm run dev:frontend"
